name: gshorts
description: Korean content harness for faceless short-form videos (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) and Instagram card news — a content-wide skill (write from opened high-performing references, record every mistake the same turn), a first-line hook template skill, a video-wide skill with every user-confirmed rule and a feedback-intake rule that writes each new piece of feedback into the matching skill, Threads and X voice skills (length caps, per-platform voice, bot-signal self-check), plus one skill per format (foreign show clips in framing D with per-show variants and five daily slots, TOP3 compilation starter, Instagram card news, Naver blog strategy from ranking and revenue-disclosing blogs). Points at an external render pipeline instead of shipping code; includes a dated 2026 short-form trend reference with sources.
